profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Results-driven Fullstack Software Engineer and Architect, adept in delivering customer-focused solutions on time. Proven expertise in design, validation, documentation and team leadership.



#nodejs #react #indigenouslanguages #STEM #indigenous #NativeCreator

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Chikashanompaꞌ Language Archive Software Engineer and Architect.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Costa Mesa, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: I am a Citizen of the Chickasaw Nation, a Federally recognized tribe located in South Central Oklahoma.  I have created Chickasaw Language specific applications for Chickasaw language teachers and students.  I have developed the software with Next.js 13.4 with Typescript, React, MongoDB, with accessible Progressive Web Apps on the Vercel serverless platform. I also constructed Node.js microservices for the Chickasaw Language word bank on a Linux server with pm2, along with MongoDB.  Currently, I am utilizing Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, and Search Console. The Progressive Web Apps are for easy string search, and regex string search for the Chickasaw word bank.  The second Progressive Web App is for Chickasaw Rosetta Stone lesson word groups, specifically for Chickasaw Community Chickasaw Language learners and their teachers. With the help and support of the Chickasaw Nation Language Revitalization Department, I was able to create both applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Webpack · React.js · JavaScript · SASS · Node.js · Redux.js · Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · ReactJS · MongoDB

positions.locationName: Greater Manchester, England, United Kingdom · Remote

positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Tailwind CSS · ReactJS · MongoDB

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Orange County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
MERN JavaScript bliss....

- Small team architect and technical lead on mission critical, accessible products.
- 2018 Recipient of the Red Eye award for dedication to project and delivery.	
- Championed and implemented Storybook with React for reusable components library.
- Championed  and implemented test coverage across software products.
- Node.js , Next.js, Express, React/Redux, MongoDB, Nginx, AWS ES2, Linux, Docker, scaleable design, implementation, and deployment on time delivery of multiple, revenue critical projects such as a full website product API and frontend rewrite as a lead engineer and architect with an amazing team.
- Architected and implemented Next.js SSO authentication site for multiple productions in our line. Next.js, with Passport, React, and MongoDB. Sign in/up with Google, Facebook, Linkedin and local strategies.
- Provided DevOps for multiple products including Linux, AWS, Docker, Jenkins, and Bitbucket Pipelines. 
- Team flagship product retool with Next.js, React, MongoDB.
positions.insights: Skills: Webpack · React.js · Redux.js · Google Tag Manager · Google Analytics

positions.title: Founder, Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implementing  AngularJs, Mongoose, Nodejs API backend, phone application using PhoneGap and Ionic framework.
positions.insights: Skills: Webpack · React.js · Redux.js · Google Tag Manager

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
•	Designed, documented, and implemented with UX team and stakeholders and small engineering team, a Google Material Angularjs and modern Perl web application atop of Danser2 MVC.  User friendly onboarding of new customers into our larger backend system.  System integrated with the Okta 3rd party authorization software.
•	Improved speed of existing software by optimizing jQuery and database calls.
•	Optimized Angularjs and javascript in current codebase.

positions.title: Advanced Interface Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for technical leadership of four software projects, including design, team leadership,        and implementation, and documentation.  Responsible for maintaining key vendor relations for one  project under  project management.  Responsible for responding to technical writers for RFP  (requests for proposals) as a key subject matter expert.  Responsible for maintaining production  software across five live projects in an on-call 24/7 environment.

•	Designed and developed improved automated image processing for our TCA customer.  There was a 30% decrease in need for human entered license plate reviews.
•	Quickly coordinated, designed, implemented and documented solution for Transportation Corridor Agency’s video tolling system in to handle a tenfold increase in image processing and data storage, including the capability to handle days worth of data smoothly without backup in data, should the vendor’s system cease to deliver data in a timely manner.   The solution was delivered ahead of schedule and with short notice from the customer.
•	Researched and analyzed issues with incoming data from a new vendor that interfaced to software that was created for Raytheon by our team.  As Project Manager of the software, spearheaded solutions and communicated with multiple parties for a satisfactory solution.
•	Sought out new resources in our newly acquired company to successfully deliver the software for a Virginia project on time and meeting all requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Primary responsibility is to design, implement, document, and test interfaces to various foreign toll road lane software interfaces to a “data hosting” software that delivers transactional and image data to a back office for further processing.
•	 As technical software lead, created detail design documents for critical review with customer for Elizabeth River Crossing tunnel project, for the host software with less than a week’s time available for execution.  Gathered technical writers to work side by side until complete.  Commitment to project success prevailed, and the design was accepted.
•	Spearheaded efforts to upgrade 3M’s imaging system for  a faster user friendly system that captured all of our image processing for all our customers.  Delivered to our two biggest customers resulting in more accurate human reviews and less errors in automated image processing.
•	Quick installation of enterprise software to new hardware, where a customer’s hardware had irreparably failed, saved the customer innumerable loses in toll revenue by quick response.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description:
To work in remote and Agile/Extreme software development work environment and  methods. 

•	Team member of 4 successfully delivered, production projects including a data hosting contract to Raytheon’s high speed video tolling lane, and TxDoT image processing system for the largest video tolling system in the US at the time.

positions.title: Software Support Services
positions.description: Provided technical assistance to customers using VESystems proprietary software.
